problem: The source-backed image-slide copy owner rejected native PowerPoint image slides before their dependency closure could be qualified. Its blanket extension-list/namespace guards rejected ordinary shape creation GUIDs, slide creation IDs, theme-family metadata and empty presentation guide-list declarations. Native identifier read/edit scopes also lacked feature-row assertions.
changes: Add a bounded passive-metadata admission proof to source-copy XML validation. It recognizes exact namespace/owner/extension-URI/payload combinations for DrawingML 2014 shape creation IDs, PowerPoint 2010 slide creation and shape modification IDs, leaf theme-family metadata and empty presentation slide-guide-list declarations.

Keep every event under the existing node/depth, relationship, namespace, MCE, DTD/PI and end-tag checks. The proof has fixed-depth owner storage, a 4096-byte per-scalar ceiling, cancellation checks and memory reservations covering decoded attributes and GUID validation. It never drops or normalizes source XML.

Retain previous core-only master/layout/theme admission and the existing destination-anchor policy. Unknown source-slide extensions, extra metadata children/attributes, relationship-bearing extensions, nonempty guide dependencies and unsupported resource graphs remain refused.

Add four native regressions and four metadata-proof unit regressions. Update the fixture index and feature matrix; clarify that the in-memory copy patch supports inverse on independently opened byte-equal artifacts, while providing no durable inverse wire format.

verification_scope.native_picture_copy: For PPTX, PPSX and POTX separately, copy visual-object slide 2 from one source instance into an independently opened equal native destination at position 0. The slide count grows from five to six. The copied slide XML, including all native creation metadata and geometry, is byte-identical to the source slide; its visible title is EMBEDDED_PICTURE_002 and its p14 creation ID remains 2058337588.
verification_scope.image_and_package_graph: The native JPEG is 83204 bytes with SHA-256 b6f8d168d41e0fc296eb1e0e3855d9669584b7528c2ef4966817443d9bc9b929. Exactly ppt/media/image1-copy1.jpg, ppt/slides/slide6.xml and its relationship member are added. The JPEG bytes remain exact; image/layout relationship ownership is checked. All original package members except the required presentation/manifests remain exact, all prior manifest entries retain their attributes, and removing the inserted slide reference reproduces the original presentation XML.
verification_scope.publication_and_inverse: Publication is deterministic and file save/reopen succeeds. Forward replay on the retained destination reproduces the artifact, and inverse on an independently opened byte-equal output restores the exact original bytes through the retained process-local patch. Both donor and destination source instances remain unchanged. These are library round trips, not fresh PowerPoint validation.
verification_scope.native_boundaries: After a valid native JPEG copy is staged, copying the native chart that owns style/color and embedded-workbook relationships fails with the exact unsupported-relationship refusal and retains the prior staged copy. Native SVG alternate relationship bindings, unequal PPTX/PPSX layout/master/theme graphs, and an MCE-bearing text-table master retain precise semantic/shared-owner/MCE refusals without changing their destination.
verification_scope.identifier_reads: Across all three visual-object variants, slide creation IDs are exactly 3852577993, 2058337588, 4165099922, 199848644 and 425733195. SmartArt/chart shape modification IDs are 1341187905 and 4245603230; absent IDs remain absent. These typed p14 values are distinct from opaque a16 creation GUIDs. Empty edit commits retain exact input bytes.
verification_scope.identifier_edits: Set the chart slide creation ID to 4000000000 and its Content Placeholder 3 modification ID to 4000000001. Giving Title 1 the same modification ID is rejected without discarding the staged changes. Only those two val attribute strings in slide4.xml change; all other bytes, including a16 GUIDs and chart/style/color/embedded workbook parts, remain exact. File save/reopen and retained-patch member inverse pass.
verification_scope.proof_regressions: Transitional/Strict owner paths, namespace aliases, minimum/maximum unsigned IDs, normative/native theme-family URI spellings and empty guides are admitted. Wrong owner/URI/payload namespaces, invalid GUIDs, overflow, relationship attributes, nested payload content, duplicate extensions, oversized scalars and nonempty guides refuse. A one-byte memory budget refuses before decoded attribute values are allocated, adequate memory admits, and reservations are released. Existing core-only theme extension admission remains unchanged.
verification_scope.specification_basis: Read-only research used MS-PPTX 2.2.9, 2.3.1.4, 2.3.3.21 and 2.4.3.4, plus MS-ODRAWXML 2.25.3.2 and 2.4.3.1. The existing DrawingML theme-family owner supplies checked GUID lexical validation and the normative/native discriminator distinction. No code or test depends on the research checkout.
verification_scope.limits: This qualifies matched dependency graphs between independent instances of each native variant, not arbitrary cross-document visual equivalence. No image decoding/rendering, chart regeneration, SVG-binding copy, broader resource closure, collaborative history, cryptographic randomness quality or fresh native application reopen is claimed. Nonempty guide-list authoring and future theme-family extension payloads remain outside the new admission profile.
